limitations: Inherited fixed frame predicates, timer-start routing and byte storage remain explicit vocabulary limits
Synthetic probes and failed unseen attempts are excluded from validated-user counts
Declared registers and synthesized sequential cells are distinct metrics
protocol_specific_count_scope: New transaction RTL; diagnostic sequential SPI reference and inherited framing predicates are listed separately

i2c_target.activity_counting_scope: PC values are registered observations. State fields are semantic dependencies, not switching/power measurements.
